disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deception in applying for, procuring, or renewing a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in the practice of architecture or in procuring any contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, gross negligence, or recklessness in the practice of architecture
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence or gross negligence or recklessness in the practice of architecture

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for a felony or relevant misdemeanor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A conviction, finding of guilt, receipt of a withheld judgment or suspended sentence in this or any other state, territory, country or jurisdiction for a felony or a misdemeanor, which misdemeanor involved a violation of the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affixing signature or seal to work not prepared by or under responsible control of the architect, or permitting name to be used to assist an unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Affixing his signature to, or impressing his seal on, any plans, drawings, specifications or other instruments of service that have not been prepared by him or under his responsible control or permitting his name to be used for the purpose of assisting any person who is not a licensed architect to evade the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving undisclosed rebates, commissions, or having undisclosed pecuniary interest in work
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Receiving rebates, commissions, grants of money or other favors in connection with the work without the knowledge of the party for whom he is working or having a pecuniary interest in the performance of the contract for the work designed, planned or supervised by him without the knowledge and consent of the owner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unethical or unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules or code of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unethical or unprofessional conduct as defined by the rules of the board or the code of ethics established by the rules of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing architecture or representing oneself as a licensed architect when unlicensed in violation of licensing laws of another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having had any professional or occupational license revoked, suspended, or otherwise disciplined in any jurisdiction

definition_quote.value: Practice of architecture means rendering or offering those services described in this subsection in connection with the design, construction, enlargement or alteration of a building or a group of buildings. The services covered within this definition include architectural planning, advice and consultation; submitting a response to any request for qualification, request for proposal, or other solicitation for services within the state; providing preliminary studies; architectural designs, drawings and specifications; technical submissions; and administration of construction contracts.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of architecture" means rendering or offering those services described in this subsection in connection with the design, construction, enlargement or alteration of a building or a group of buildings. The services covered within this definition include architectural planning, advice and consultation; submitting a response to any request for qualification, request for proposal, or other solicitation for services within the state; providing preliminary studies; architectural designs, drawings and specifications; technical submissions; and administration of construction contracts.

methods_authorized.quote: architectural planning, advice and consultation; submitting a response to any request for qualification, request for proposal, or other solicitation for services within the state; providing preliminary studies; architectural designs, drawings and specifications; technical submissions; and administration of construction contracts.

seal_required.quote: Every licensed architect shall have a seal, the impression of which must contain the name and Idaho architect license number of the architect and the words "licensed architect" and "state of Idaho," with which he shall seal all technical submissions issued from his office.

exempt_building_types.quote: The rendering of any architectural service required in the erection, enlargement, alteration or repair of any building, where the building is to be or is used as a single or multiple family residence not exceeding three (3) units or three (3) stories in height; or as a farm building; or for the purpose of outbuildings or auxiliary buildings in connection with the residential or farm premises.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: The following acts shall be unlawful and punishable as a misdemeanor: Practicing or offering to engage in the practice of architecture, as defined in this chapter, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license issued under this chapter

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: Imposition of an administrative fine not to exceed two thousand dollars ($2,000) per violation.
